summary: Measure postharvest losses, assess storage and cold-chain costs, and connect quality to margins. Explore the course and plan your training.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals responsible for postharvest handling, quality, storage, aggregation or commercial decisions across food value chains.
prerequisites: Working exposure to agribusiness, food handling, processing, storage, quality assurance or value-chain operations is recommended. No coding is required. Basic spreadsheet skills will support the Excel exercises.
